key_points_original: anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python released v1.5.0, marked as the latest version, published by stainless-app on 10 Sep at 17:45.

Features include api: add auto mode tool permissions for Managed Agents, api: add content_too_large web_fetch tool error code, and api: add the user-profiles-2026-09-04 beta value and external_user_details to user profiles.

Features also include api: support mounting public GitHub repositories without an authorization_token in Managed Agents sessions, client: add Message.to_param() and BetaMessage.to_param(), credentials: add CredentialsError and IdentityTokenFileError, and tools: accept tool objects directly in messages.create, parse, stream and count_tokens.

Bug fixes include merging extra_body before client hooks run, refusing credentials files accessible by group or others, keeping partial tool input JSON off content blocks, and leaving parsed_output out of dumped text blocks.
translation: anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python 发布了 v1.5.0，标记为最新版本，由 stainless-app 于 9 月 10 日 17:45 发布。

新功能包括：api: add auto mode tool permissions for Managed Agents、api: add content_too_large web_fetch tool error code，以及 api: add the user-profiles-2026-09-04 beta value and external_user_details to user profiles。

新功能还包括：api: support mounting public GitHub repositories without an authorization_token in Managed Agents sessions、client: add Message.to_param() and BetaMessage.to_param()、credentials: add CredentialsError and IdentityTokenFileError，以及 tools: accept tool objects directly in messages.create, parse, stream and count_tokens。

缺陷修复包括：merge extra_body before client hooks run、refuse credentials files accessible by group or others、keep partial tool input JSON off content blocks，以及 leave parsed_output out of dumped text blocks。
items.summary_cn: anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python 发布最新版本 v1.5.0，由 stainless-app 于 9 月 10 日 17:45 发布。该版本新增 Managed Agents 自动模式工具权限、content_too_large web_fetch 工具错误码、user-profiles-2026-09-04 beta 值与 external_user_details、无需 authorization_token 挂载公共 GitHub 仓库、Message.to_param() 与 BetaMessage.to_param()、CredentialsError 与 IdentityTokenFileError，以及 tools 直接接受工具对象等；并修复 extra_body 合并时机、凭据文件权限、流式工具输入 JSON 与 parsed_output 转储等问题。
items.summary_en: anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python released v1.5.0 as the latest version, published by stainless-app on 10 Sep at 17:45. It adds auto mode tool permissions for Managed Agents, a content_too_large web_fetch tool error code, the user-profiles-2026-09-04 beta value and external_user_details, mounting public GitHub repositories without an authorization_token, Message.to_param() and BetaMessage.to_param(), CredentialsError and IdentityTokenFileError, and direct tool objects in messages.create, parse, stream and count_tokens; bug fixes cover extra_body merging, credentials file permissions, streaming tool input JSON, and parsed_output in dumped text blocks.
items.relevance: Anthropic 官方 Python SDK 的版本更新，对使用 Managed Agents 与相关 API 的开发者有直接影响。
